scope: Proposition 8.5 (Finitely many persistent profiles) of the manuscript “Directional transience implies ballisticity” (preprints/Directional-transience-implies-ballisticity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 220 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8b305d1fbb11b2a6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On E, there is no dust. The proper classes form the same finite nonempty set at every time, and the profile of each class has full support on horizontal space.
